title: Croissant+
description: Adds a croissant item for creative mode and testing.
body:
# Croissant+ adds a simple croissant item to Minecraft.

**The croissant is currently available only in Creative mode and is intended for fun, decoration, or testing purposes.**
No survival crafting recipe is included at the moment.

This mod is lightweight and focuses on adding a small bakery-style touch to the game.
More features and survival support may be added in future updates.
